propositions: 108 store tickets carry Success Criteria as plain bullets instead of checkboxes, making them invisible to _count_ac_items and plan-review blocking floor logic
A migration script must convert Success Criteria bullets to Acceptance Criteria checkboxes via rebar.edit_ticket, handling tickets with SC-only, both headings, mixed formats, and no SC block

The migration must process closed tickets by default and require an explicit flag for open/in_progress tickets to avoid silently invalidating in-flight plan-review attestations with stale-material fingerprints
Post-migration verification must confirm zero Success Criteria headings remain, all 106 migrated tickets meet the AC floor (_count_ac_items >= 1), and the rewrite is order-agnostic and idempotent

Qualified heading variants (Success Criteria with parentheticals) must be normalized to canonical Acceptance Criteria heading during migration to prevent qualifier text from leaking into checklist items
